verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents a real REST API: an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, a ReadMe-hosted reference with per-endpoint Try It consoles, a separate sandbox server and a URL-versioned v0 with a stability statement. However, access is request-gated by email, sandbox credentials are provisioned manually, and the vendor says the API was originally architected for platform-to-platform embedded integrations rather than end-user self-serve driving. Missing for 10: self-serve API key access for individual users, a formal deprecation/changelog policy, a prose-linked spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Puzzle publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document (info title "Puzzle Api", server https://app.puzzle.io/rest/v0) on its app domain
The ReadMe-hosted API reference ships the live "Try It!" console per endpoint
Puzzle documents a sandbox separate from production
Our API was originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations.
